summary: Iter 22 — Geo-aware check-ins: (a) muster bulk endpoints now accept optional coach GPS + echo/stamp site info, (b) SelfCheckIn shows GeoPermissionBanner on denied, OutOfGeofenceModal on out-of-geofence check-ins, (c) muster shows window.confirm off-site + 'Mustering at <site>' toast on-site. Backend: 72/72 tests green in one run (65 regression + 4 muster_gps + 3 new iter22 review). Verified via new iter22 review tests that (i) muster with GPS inside a satellite training-location stamps site_id/site_name that then surfaces on /api/presence's on_campus row, (ii) geo-toggle `reason` field is persisted as `geo_reason` on the attendance row when out=True (checked directly against Mongo), (iii) `reason` is NOT stamped when the check-in lands inside a geofence. Frontend Playwright verified end-to-end on /my-check-in: geo-permission-banner visible when Permissions API returns 'denied' (with correct Chrome/Safari/Firefox-specific fix hint), OutOfGeofenceModal opens on out-of-geofence 'I showed up' with distance readout '~8667068 m from Campus Office', 5 quick-pick chips, required textarea, confirm disabled with <3 chars and enabled after chip pick, check-in succeeds and modal dismisses, checkout on out-of-geofence does NOT re-open modal. On /muster: GeoPermissionBanner mounted, submitting from off-site triggered window.confirm('~8667068 m from Campus Office. Continue mustering from here?…') which was auto-accepted and the batch proceeded. All admin pages loaded without page-errors in the crawl.
critical_code_review_comments: services/geo.resolve_site intentionally returns (None, None) when the closest candidate is the *main* office (backwards compat); this creates an observable asymmetry with utils.js resolveNearestSite() on the frontend which DOES return office.name. Net effect: the 'Checked in at <site_name>' toast on /my-check-in NEVER includes 'Campus Office' text — only satellite sites. Ditto the 'Mustering at <site_name>' toast on /muster. Not a bug per se (both files agree the office is intentionally anonymised on the row), but the toast copy in the review request implies office-name inclusion. Consider aligning: either backend returns office.name too, or a comment on utils.js documents that the toast will silently skip when the resolved geofence is the office.

OutOfGeofenceModal.jsx has an accessibility gap: the wrapping backdrop <div onClick={onClose}> catches clicks that bubble from the inner modal's chip buttons — currently guarded by stopPropagation on the inner card, but any future child element without stopPropagation on click (or a keydown handler) can accidentally close the modal. Consider using a Radix dialog primitive or an explicit `data-outside-close` sentinel instead of naïve target === currentTarget checks.

useGeoPermission.js: `setState(permStatus.state)` is called inside the change-event listener without checking `cancelled`, but permStatus itself is a live object; if the component unmounts while a change event fires, we still call setState on an unmounted component. React 18 tolerates it silently but a strict-mode warning may surface. Wrap the change handler with the `cancelled` guard.

Muster.jsx confirm() dialog string interpolates `resolved.nearest_distance_m ?? '?'` — for very large distances this renders as e.g. '8667068 m' (unformatted). Human-readable formatting (km when >1000m, comma-separated) would make coaches parse it faster in the field.

SelfCheckIn.jsx: performToggle sends `{ latitude: 0, longitude: 0 }` when no GPS was obtained — this exercises the backend geo_unavailable sentinel branch, but the frontend then ALWAYS pops the OutOfGeofenceModal-check step BEFORE that fallback. So the modal is skipped for GPS-less check-ins. Intended? If yes, add a code comment; otherwise users on a locked-down browser (denied permission → no fix → skips the client resolve) will silently check in without a reason ever being asked.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_review_iter22.py (new — 3 review tests for satellite-site site_name propagation to /presence, geo_reason persistence when out, geo_reason omitted when in)
seed_data_creation: test_review_iter22 creates and deletes a 'TEST_Iter22 Regatta Venue' satellite site (lat 41, lng -76, radius 150m, active=true) within the muster+presence test, and toggles an admin check-in/out (off-site then off-site again) to leave state clean. All state is reverted in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Muster bulk endpoints (/api/muster/checkin-bulk|checkout-bulk) accept optional latitude/longitude and echo {site_id, site_name, out_of_geofence, distance_m} on the response. Backend's services.geo.resolve_site() returns (None, None) when the closest geofence is the MAIN OFFICE and only names SATELLITE sites — so /api/presence's `site_name` will be None for members inside the office radius and only populate for members inside a configured satellite site. If retesting site_name propagation, create a satellite via POST /api/sites {name,latitude,longitude,radius_m,active:true} and muster INSIDE it. GeoPermissionBanner shows only when navigator.permissions.query({name:'geolocation'}) resolves to 'denied' — in Playwright, use an init-script Object.defineProperty override on navigator.permissions.query (context.grant_permissions([]) alone doesn't flip the Permissions API to 'denied'). Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_review_iter22.py. Run: TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD='Admin@12345' pytest tests/test_muster_gps.py tests/test_review_iter22.py. New iter22 review comments (see critical_code_review_comments) call out an intentional-but-confusing asymmetry between frontend/backend site-name resolution for the main office.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature acceptance pass. Every claim in the review request is verified except one nuance: the review says 'success toast reads Checked in at <site_name>' for INSIDE check-ins, but because backend returns site_name=None when the closest geofence is the main office, that toast currently reads simply 'Checked in — welcome, <name>!' (no location bit) for main-office check-ins. It DOES include site_name for satellite-site check-ins (verified against test_muster_inside_satellite_site_stamps_site_on_presence).
